title: Missy Zombor
description: Campaigned with the Milwaukee DSA (Democratic Socialists of America)
body:
# Missy Zombor

# School Board President

![](/media/uploads/2026/07/Missy-zombor.webp)

Campaigned with the [Milwaukee DSA](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/700fe0e8-1d45-4ef9-bed7-11c5c8ea078a/Milwaukee-Zombor-DSA-FB-post.png) (Democratic Socialists of America)

Led the effort to remove school resource officers (SROs) [from schools saying](https://web.archive.org/web/20260322101612/https:/www.wuwm.com/milwaukee-students-rally-against-armed-police-schools-reform),

“Early contact with the justice system significantly increases the likelihood that students disengage from school all together. And the psychological impacts of constant police presence can be real and lasting, especially for Black students and students with disabilities,” Zombor said. “Without clear and strict guardrails, it’s easy for SROs to become the default response to all behavior challenges.”

Sponsored [a resolution](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/109ac77c-a2d2-4a63-87ed-cb0258b80635/Milwaukee-Zombor-SRO-resolution.pdf) that said the school district is “committed to strengthening school safety and emergency response protocols through non-police methods that promote student and staff well-being without unnecessary reliance on law enforcement”

Promoted leftist student activism on school grounds:

- “Defend students’ right to speak out on Palestine”
- “Keep ICE and police out of our classrooms”
- “School lunch justice”
